The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm, so I used that as the ruler.

**Ribs:** There are two rib sections, each about 20 cm long and 4–5 cm wide. They are meaty but fairly thin, so each is roughly 2.5 cm tall. That gives about 100–120 g of meat and bone per section, around 220 g for both. Bone makes up part of that weight, so I counted the edible portion at about 170 g and used a bone-in rib value of 250 kcal/100 g.

**Baby carrots:** There are four pieces, each about 5–6 cm long, and at roughly 10 g each they come to about 40 g. Cooked carrots are about 35 kcal/100 g.
